notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR page. It gives no build year, design, height or builder. Two WebSearch queries found nothing about this tower; the results were other Cedar Grove places and fire departments. The Forest Lookouts page at easternuslookouts.weebly.com/cedar-grove.html is a Livingston County, Kentucky tower and was not used. The brief's status standing is not stated by any fetched source; the 2021 photo caption is the only dated evidence, so status is left out of facts. Brief elevation_m 48.5 agrees with the Register's 159 ft (48 m) to rounding. The NHLR photo cedar-grove.jpg is already in the photo manifest and its license is not stated on the page, so no photo is added.
